packages.label: הַלֵּב וּדְבַר ה'
packages.label_en: The Heart and the Word of God
packages.reason: This Torah presents a single unified teaching: the heart (לֵב) is the dwelling-place of the essence of divinity (עִקַּר הָאֱלֹקוּת), and therefore whatever the heart speaks is literally the word of God (דִּבְרֵי ה' מַמָּשׁ). The heart is not merely a metaphor — it is identified directly with the divine presence. The Rebbe proves this from the verse 'צוּר לְבָבִי' (Rock of my heart = God) and from Rashi's reading of the opening verse. Within this cluster: בַּר לֵבָב (pure/empty of heart) is the human subject who has purified the heart, characterized as being בִּבְחִינַת 'וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי' — whose heart is hollow/empty within him, making it a perfect vessel for divine speech. The Torah's conceptual equation is: emptied heart = divine speech = prophetic knowledge of the future. All these concepts share the same essential nature: the heart as a transparent channel for the divine voice. The emptying (חָלַל) is not a separate idea from being 'bar levav' — it IS what being bar levav means, hence the explicit bechina relationship. 'לְךָ' (to You) = 'בִּשְׁלִיחוּתְךָ' (in Your commission) is Rashi's bechina-equivalence, identifying the heart's speech as delegated divine speech. This entire cluster belongs to the positive/holy domain: the heart is the good vessel for God's presence.

packages.label: יְדִיעַת עֲתִידוֹת
packages.reason: Knowing the future (יְדִיעַת עֲתִידוֹת) is the eitza-result produced by the hollow heart receiving divine speech — 'יוּכַל לֵידַע עֲתִידוֹת, עַל־יְדֵי מַה שֶּׁהַלֵּב אוֹמֵר לוֹ'. The language 'עַל־יְדֵי' (through/by means of) is the standard eitza marker in Rebbe Nachman's teachings, not a bechina-equivalence marker. Strictly speaking, this is a single-node concept that receives an eitza arrow from Package 1. However, within the topology of this Torah, the teaching culminates in this concept: knowing the future IS what divine speech from the heart produces. The verse 'לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי' is the textual proof that the heart commissions/speaks prophetically. As a standalone concept with no bechina peers, it is listed here as a separate minimal package to preserve the framework rule that every node belongs to exactly one package. It cannot be merged into Package 1 by shared-nature bechina — the connection is explicitly eitza ('through what the heart says → one can know the future'). It is good polarity: prophetic knowledge is a gift of the holy domain.
